blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Here are INQToday’s top stories this afternoon: Lawyers representing victims of former President Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war have backed prosecutors’ bid to admit three testimonies in the crimes against humanity case before the International Criminal Court. In Cebu City, defense ministers from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations are gathering for their regional meeting, with security cooperation and shared challenges on the agenda. READ: LIVE UPDATES; 20th Asean Defense Ministers’ Meeting in Cebu Meanwhile, air travelers may face higher fares beginning in early November, adding to travel costs as passengers prepare for trips in the coming weeks./dp...
